return.message: You do not have access to collect a credit payment in this workspace.
Only a completed credit bill can receive a payment.

actions.script: def txn = ec.service.sync().name('zenith.pos.PosCreditServices.get#ScopedPosCreditBills') .parameters([sourceModuleId:sourceModuleId,transactionId:transactionId]).call()?.bills?.find() if (!txn) return def payments = ec.entity.find('zenith.erp.pos.PosPayment').condition('transactionId',transactionId).orderBy('paymentDate,paymentId').list() def total = (txn.payableAmount ?: 0) as BigDecimal def running = BigDecimal.ZERO def rows = payments.collect { payment -> running += (payment.amount ?: 0) as BigDecimal def person = payment.recordedByPartyId ? ec.entity.find('mantle.party.Person').condition('partyId',payment.recordedByPartyId).one() : null [paymentId:payment.paymentId, date:payment.paymentDate ? ec.l10n.format(payment.paymentDate,'dd MMM yyyy, hh:mm:ss a z') : null, amount:payment.amount, method:payment.paymentMethod, reference:payment.referenceNumber ?: payment.digitalTransactionId ?: '', recordedBy:person ? [person.firstName,person.lastName].findAll { it }.join(' ') : 'Not recorded (legacy)', balance:(total - running).max(BigDecimal.ZERO)] } def remaining = (total - running).max(BigDecimal.ZERO) def due = txn.creditDueDate?.toLocalDate() def zone = java.time.ZoneId.of(txn.creditTimeZone ?: ec.user.timeZone.ID) def today = ec.user.nowTimestamp.toInstant().atZone(zone).toLocalDate() def daysRemaining = due ? java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(today,due) : null def status = txn.statusId != 'PtCompleted' ? 'Cancelled' : remaining == 0 ? 'Settled' : due == null ? 'Due date not set' : daysRemaining < 0 ? 'Overdue' : daysRemaining <= 2 ? 'Due soon' : 'Open' def customer = txn.customerPartyId ? ec.entity.find('mantle.party.Party').condition('partyId',txn.customerPartyId).one() : null def policy = txn.customerPartyId ? ec.entity.find('zenith.erp.pos.PosCreditReminderPolicy') .condition('organizationPartyId',txn.organizationPartyId).condition('customerPartyId',txn.customerPartyId).one() : null history = [transactionId:transactionId, billNo:txn.transactionNumber, customer:txn.customerName, customerPartyId:txn.customerPartyId, total:total, paid:running, outstanding:remaining, payments:rows, lastPayment:rows ? rows[-1].date : null, settledOn:status == 'Settled' && rows ? rows[-1].date : null, dueDate:due?.toString(), creditDays:txn.creditDays, customerCreditDays:customer?.creditDays, daysRemaining:daysRemaining, status:status, dueTimeZone:zone.id, termChanges:ec.entity.find('zenith.erp.pos.PosCreditTermsChange').condition('organizationPartyId',txn.organizationPartyId) .condition('customerPartyId',txn.customerPartyId).orderBy('-changedDate,-changeId').limit(50).list() .findAll { !it.transactionId || it.transactionId == transactionId }.collect { change -> [date:ec.l10n.format(change.changedDate,'dd MMM yyyy, hh:mm a z'),reason:change.reason, scope:change.transactionId ? 'This bill due date' : 'Customer default days', before:change.transactionId ? change.oldDueDate?.toString() : change.oldDays, after:change.transactionId ? change.newDueDate?.toString() : change.newDays] }, canManageTerms:ec.user.isInGroup('ADMIN') || ec.user.isInGroup('ZENITH_ADMIN'), reminders:ec.entity.find('zenith.erp.pos.PosCreditReminder').condition('organizationPartyId',txn.organizationPartyId) .condition('transactionId',transactionId).orderBy('-createdDate').list().collect { r -> [date:ec.l10n.format(r.createdDate,'dd MMM yyyy, hh:mm a z'),channel:r.channel,status:r.deliveryStatus, amount:r.outstandingAmount,error:r.failureReason] }, reminderPolicy:[consent:policy?.consent ?: 'N', intervalDays:policy?.intervalDays ?: 7, maxAttempts:policy?.maxAttempts ?: 3, channel:policy?.channel ?: 'SMS']]
